reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Update standalone User Operator to handle Cluster CA cert Secret being missing when TLS is not needed", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: none

consequence.statement: The User Operator no longer fails when the Cluster CA certificate Secret is missing in non-TLS configurations.

proposed.statement: The standalone User Operator was updated to gracefully handle the Cluster CA certificate Secret being absent when TLS is not needed.
